name: prompt-1081
image_vibe: Moody minimalist black tailoring with a sharp devil-horn shadow metaphor
image_purpose: Create a conceptual editorial portrait expressing inner conflict and duality.

prompt.project_info: A vertical conceptual portrait of an original adult woman in black tailoring with a symbolic horned shadow on a warm off-white wall.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman in a matte black tailored blazer with structured shoulders and a fitted silhouette, dark-brown hair in a messy bun with loose strands, and a pensive introspective expression. She faces right in three-quarter profile with her right index finger touching her lips in a contemplative gesture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical mid-torso crop with the subject slightly left of center, large empty wall space on the right for the projected shadow, eye-level standard-to-short-telephoto perspective, and clear contrast between the composed subject and symbolic horned silhouette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Single hard directional light from front-left creating a sharp high-contrast shadow on the wall, dramatic psychological mood, low saturation, warm beige and soft-brown environment, and controlled chiaroscuro.
prompt.technical_specs: Standard-to-short-telephoto perspective, moderate depth of field keeping subject and shadow in focus, realistic painted-wall grain, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, minimal distortion, high-resolution conceptual editorial photography, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical conceptual editorial portrait of an original adult woman in a matte black tailored blazer with structured shoulders and a fitted silhouette. Style her dark-brown hair in a messy bun with loose strands framing the face. Place her slightly left of center in a mid-torso three-quarter profile facing right, with her right index finger touching her lips in a pensive contemplative gesture and her gaze directed off-frame. Leave large empty space on the right side of a warm off-white or light-beige painted wall and cast a sharp human silhouette with exaggerated devil horns onto it. Use a single hard directional light from front-left, high-contrast chiaroscuro, low saturation, realistic skin and wall-grain texture, standard-to-short-telephoto perspective, moderate depth of field, subtle film grain, and no text or watermark. The shadow is a symbolic visual metaphor for inner conflict, not a literal creature.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, graphic horror, literal demon, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed shadow, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source psychological shadow portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for black blazer, finger-to-lips contemplative pose, beige wall, hard light, and horned-shadow metaphor; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, black tailoring, messy bun, right-side negative space, sharp horned shadow, and psychological duality. Identity and non-essential studio details may vary.
